FREEDOM ROCK PROJECT DEDICATED

By
Woody Gottburg
-
Nov 10, 2026

SIOUXLAND FREEDOM PARK IN SOUTH SIOUX CITY CELEBRATED THE FIRST PHASE OF THE FREEDOM ROCK SHELTER PROJECT WITH A RIBBON CUTTING TUESDAY MORNING.

PARK BOARD SECRETARY DIANA KINCAID SAYS THE PROJECT IS TO PROTECT AND SHOWCASE THE 21 TON FREEDOM ROCK HONORING LOCAL VETERANS PAINTED BY BUBBA SORENSEN IN 2021 FOR THE PARK:
